ctx.x: But obviously not something that was an indelible memory. Then another date that jumps out in that same period in June is Afro-Cuban Influences, Shorty Rogers. He had eight percussionists on this date. That‟s what really caught my ear. This is June 19th, 1958, Afro-Cuban Influences, the big band of Shorty Rogers, featuring the Giants: Shorty, Al Porcino – I‟m just going down, seeing names – Frank Rosolino, Harry Betts, George Roberts, Bud Shank, Herb Geller, Bill Holman, Bill Hood, Bob Cooper, Shelly Manne on…
RCA, when they go for it – let‟s really do it up. Some of those guys were local. Mike Pacheco and – the first one?
Modesto Duran? Carlos Vidal? Luis Miranda?
